item.title: NU Board of Regents approves Katherine Ankerson as interim chancellor at UNL
item.description: LINCOLN, Neb. (KLKN) — The University of Nebraska Board of Regents on Friday approved the appointment of Katherine Ankerson as interim chancellor for the University of Nebraska-Lincoln. Ankerson takes over the role following the resignation of Rodney Bennett, who served as UNL’s chancellor from mid-2023 until January.
